subject: MATHEMATICS
prompt_intent: Use two short equations and ask which one-step transformations preserve the same solution set, with no word-problem load.
success_evidence: Learner identifies legal same-operation-on-both-sides transformations and rejects deletion/cancellation without justification.
failure_evidence: Learner accepts a transformation that changes the equality relation.

subject: MATHEMATICS
prompt_intent: Ask the learner to distinguish a variable, an expression in that variable, and an equation, then track one substitution.
success_evidence: Learner preserves dependence of the expression and does not treat it as a new independent variable.
failure_evidence: Learner collapses a compound expression into an unrelated scalar/variable.

subject: MATHEMATICS
prompt_intent: Expand one positive and one negative binomial square with small integers and no geometry context.
success_evidence: Both expansions contain the two squared terms and correctly signed cross term.
failure_evidence: Structural cross-term or squared-term error recurs.

subject: MATHEMATICS
prompt_intent: Give two labelled points and ask the learner to identify Δx, Δy, then construct slope before numerical simplification.
success_evidence: Learner preserves x/y roles and writes Δy/Δx consistently.
failure_evidence: Learner swaps coordinate roles or constructs Δx/Δy as slope.

subject: MATHEMATICS
prompt_intent: Provide a candidate solution to a simple system and ask only whether it is valid by substitution.
success_evidence: Learner substitutes into each original equation and accepts/rejects the candidate based on both checks.
failure_evidence: Learner cannot or does not compare the candidate against the original equations.
